_doc: World Heroes Perfect victim postures (export_bm.VICTIM_POSES['whp'], the vocabulary of tools/kof96/victim_poses98.json: posture + angle relative to the sprite's facing, 0 upright, 90 horizontal head toward the facing side, 180 head down). Keys 'throw anim.step' of the thrower (export_whp.throw_export): the victim def its command 16 places at that step, Hanzou's own defs as the victim (row 1). Read by eye 2026-10-06 from /data/tmp/whp6/victim_defs.png (render of every held step: D1 = the forward throw, D3 = the back throw).
